construction_method: release_time = earliest recorded timestamp among the round's workload shots; planned_time = recorded timestamp at which the pair's recorded outcomes were complete (later shot); deterministic, no random seed
device_note: slot grid identical to the previous evaluation (capacity unchanged)
outcomes: recorded outcomes carried as metadata for replay; nothing is newly measured
partition: holdout (last 25% of the timeline, the partition the three-policy evaluation scores)
randomness: none: the workload is a deterministic function of the recorded trace and the registry
request_pairing: existing production round-robin matching over the Comparable pairs (unchanged)
shots_per_request: 1 shot of each of the two circuits (2 per request), as in the previous evaluation
